shipping_assumption: Free shipping, so $100 is the whole order; postage cost not counted
conditions: Final value fee 13.6% on the total amount of the sale up to $7,500 + $0.40 per-order fee (orders over $10). The total includes shipping charged and sales tax: with 8% sales tax the fee base is $108 and you keep $84.91 (low end of range). First 250 listings a month have no insertion fee.

shipping_assumption: Buyer pays Poshmark's shipping label on top of the price; commission is on the $100 price
conditions: US: flat $2.95 on sales under $15; 20% commission on sales of $15 or more. Official support article (support.poshmark.com/s/article/297755057) failed TLS verification for our fetcher; the same fee text appears on Poshmark's own blog FAQ.

shipping_assumption: Free shipping, so $100 is the whole order (fee also applies to buyer-paid shipping)
conditions: 10% selling fee on item price + buyer-paid shipping for listings created or updated since 2025-01-06; no payment processing fee; buyer pays a 3.6% Buyer Protection fee. Direct deposit payout free ($2 only if a deposit fails); Instant Pay fee not verified (page layout ambiguous).

shipping_assumption: Free shipping, so $100 is the whole order (processing also applies to shipping and tax)
conditions: No Depop selling fee for US sellers; Depop Payments (Stripe) processing 3.3% + $0.45 on price + shipping + tax. Low end of range: buyer came through a Boosted Listing (12% boosting fee for US listings from 2026-03-23). With 8% sales tax you keep $95.99.

shipping_assumption: Free shipping, so $100 is the whole order
conditions: Checkout Terms (last modified 2026-05-26): Marketplace selling fee 10%, minimum $0.80, on the entire transaction including shipping and taxes; payment-provider fees may be charged separately. Conflict: Facebook's sell-with-shipping page says 'only 5%' (would keep $95.00). The 10% legal figure is used.

shipping_assumption: No shipping; buyer pays in person
conditions: Inferred, not stated outright: Facebook's Selling Fees apply to Marketplace checkout transactions; a local cash/off-platform sale does not go through checkout. No Facebook page found that says 'local sales are free'.
Not available: OfferUp ended nationwide shipping. No new shipped listings from 2025-09-23; shipping removed from all listings by 2025-10-21. No current shipped fee exists.

shipping_assumption: No shipping; buyer pays in person
conditions: Core buying and selling features are free. Paid extras: promotions, extra listings beyond the free monthly allotment in some categories, Premium. Buyer and seller settle payment directly for in-person deals.

shipping_assumption: Buyer pays shipping and the Vinted fee on top
conditions: No selling fees: the seller gets the full price in their Vinted Wallet. The buyer pays the Vinted fee (formerly Buyer Protection fee), typically 5% + $0.70. Wallet-to-bank withdrawal fees not verified.

shipping_assumption: Free shipping, so $100 is the whole order (transaction fee also applies to charged shipping)
conditions: $0.20 listing + 6.5% transaction fee + 3% + $0.25 US Etsy Payments processing (processing is also charged on sales tax; tax not counted here). Low end of range = sale attributed to Offsite Ads at 15%. Same fees as handmade.
